recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not re-add removed extension rows or inactive SupplyRequest entries to core for FHIR-26950; any future request-replaces maintenance belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack, and any future SupplyRequest resource maintenance belongs in the repository/build that now owns the OO resources.
issue_request: FHIR-26950 asked to support replacement of supply orders by adding SupplyRequest to the relevant replaces extension context. The Jira comments and application history identify the applied artifact as http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/request-replaces rather than the conformance-resource replaces extension.
initial_application: Core commits b2aa580518 and da51c37c6a, merged as 8777854ebe, changed source/profiles/request-extensions-spreadsheet.xml so the request-pattern replaces row listed NutritionOrder;SupplyRequest. A Zulip committers thread shows the assignee initially looked at the wrong extension and then corrected course.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f17 removed standard extension definitions from the R5 source, and the Extension Pack first imported request-replaces with SupplyRequest already listed. The current Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* and StructureDefinition-request-replaces.xml still contains SupplyRequest context. Core commit 3b38b80cf2 later removed SupplyRequest from active fhir.ini build lists, so current SupplyRequest resource changes are also outside this core build. FHIR-43453 later added a native SupplyRequest.replaces element before that move and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined FHIR branch. The core checkout was left unchanged because the authoritative extension definition now lives in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions and already satisfies the FHIR-26950 request.
